historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission voted 5 to 1 to find the conversion of the building's 24 apartments and one room, then renting for $300 to $550, into 24 condominiums to sell for $85,000 to $140,000 consistent with the Master Plan (Resolution 7868).

The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the denial of a permit to alter the building at 2201 Sacramento Street, requiring sprinkler heads or tempered glass for windows opening onto fire escape balconies and window openings at least 29 inches wide.

hook: A 1928 condominium building whose 24 apartments are held as 24 separate parcels, four to a floor.

narrative.lead: 2201 Sacramento Street is a condominium building of 1928 whose 24 apartments are held as 24 separate parcels — lots 017 through 040 on block 0638 — numbered 101 through 604, four to a floor across six floors.
